'Trustworthy' = deserving trust; 'trusted' also works but 'trustworthy' is the quality.

gaps.sentence: He is one of the most ___ (INFLUENCE) thinkers of the decade.
gaps.explanation: 'Influential' describes a person who influences others.

gaps.sentence: The refugees celebrated their ___ (FREE) at last.
The mountain road has been ___ (WIDE) to cope with coach traffic.
gaps.explanation: Passive 'has been widened' — the verb form meaning made wider.

gaps.sentence: The economy showed further ___ (WEAK) in the third quarter.
gaps.explanation: 'Further weakness' — the noun form follows the adjective 'further'.
